ai_showcase.title: How I Build with AI Agents
ai_showcase.subtitle: AI writes code fast. What makes it production-ready is the process around it: a plan I approve, a second agent reviewing, and checks on every change.

steps.title: Plan
steps.desc: The ticket becomes a short plan: files, approach and risks. I approve it before any code is written.

steps.title: Implement
steps.desc: An implementer agent (Claude Code or Codex) writes the code on its own branch, following the project's patterns.

steps.title: Review
steps.desc: A reviewer agent reads the diff, while typecheck, lint and tests must pass. Findings go back to the implementer.

steps.title: Ship
steps.desc: I test it in the real app, open the pull request and follow it to merge. Nothing ships without a human check.

ai_showcase.note: Tools: Claude Code, Codex, Git, Jira. Used daily at Flugo and in my own projects.
